lang.preview.title: Preview
lang.preview.text: The setup will proceed in this language. AnimaWorks is a framework that treats AI agents as autonomous "animas". Each Anima has their own identity, memory, and decision-making criteria, and acts autonomously.

env.install.claude: Claude (Pro/Max): run `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`, then start `claude` and sign in
env.install.codex: Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro): run `npm install -g @openai/codex`, then `codex login`
env.imagestyle.desc: Choose a style for character images. Both asset types can be generated and switched via theme toggle.

env.claude_code.login_hint: Run `claude` in a terminal and sign in with your browser. Then click "Verify".
env.codex.login_hint: Click "Browser login" or run `codex login` in a terminal. Then click "Verify".
